title: Norm-Cone Conjugation for Nonconvex Optimization: Scalar Duality and Exact Distance Penalization
summary: We develop a norm-cone conjugation framework, generated by translated norm-cones \[ x\mapsto r-α\|x-x_0\|, \qquad α\geq 0. \] We show that this family generates the same abstract-convex class as the family of Lipschitz continuous concave functions, and exploit its explicit metric structure to obtain a concrete support geometry, a Fenchel--Moreau-type biconjugation theorem, and an associated norm-cone subdifferential.
